profile.role_note: Free main character in Spectro form; Spectro Frazzle applicator.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free main character in Spectro form; build them as a Frazzle applicator for Zani or Phoebe teams — replaced once limited options arrive.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Emerald of Genesis (or Blazing Brilliance) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Spectro DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and treat Energy Regen as a top priority — their Liberation is the main source of Spectro Frazzle stacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner 5-star; extra Energy Regen improves Liberation uptime, which is everything for Frazzle application. Not a signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: More premium, damage-oriented option for certain teams.

ranked_weapons.name: Overture
ranked_weapons.note: Ideal 4-star for its Energy Regen plus Concerto Energy on skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Endless Collapse
ranked_weapons.note: Resonance Energy and ATK on Resonance Skill; usable 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Fables of Wisdom
ranked_weapons.note: ATK buff on hitting enemies with Negative Statuses; another usable 4-star.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen for Liberation uptime plus an ATK buff for the incoming DPS on Outro. Heron adds Resonance Energy and more DMG to the next character.

echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: Damage-oriented secondary option that works with the Spectro Frazzle mechanic; less effective for buffing the DPS.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Niche third option once S4 unlocks their Liberation healing; moves them into an even more supportive playstyle.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for their sub-DPS damage.
Spectro DMG on both; swap one to Energy Regen if the Liberation isn't cycling.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; ER is a top priority (less so after S3)

teams.name: Premium: Zani + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper

members.name: Zani
members.note: Spectro Frazzle payoff DPS; her damage scales off Frazzle stacks.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Dedicated Spectro Frazzle applicator; one of only three characters who can apply it.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and extra healing for sustainability; Mornye, Verina, and Buling are documented replacements.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Rover builds Forte to at least half, casts enhanced Resonance Skill for Frazzle and the Shimmer debuff, then Liberation and Outro into Zani's full combo. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm at the end.

teams.name: Alternative: Phoebe + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Documented main DPS replacement for Zani through her Absolution state.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Same Frazzle application role; Moonlit Clouds buffs the incoming DPS.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing and Crit buffs; Verina is the documented replacement.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with Stellarealm, Phoebe enters Confession mode and stacks Spectro Frazzle with Heavy Attacks and Liberation, Rover tops up Frazzle stacks and Outro buffs, then the DPS closes the rotation.
